Fixes a rate limiter bug where NTP clock step-backs cause negative elapsed time, silently draining tokens and locking out callers. The diff clamps negative elapsed time to zero and moves the capacity clamp to immediately follow refilling. This ensures accurate token accounting despite system clock synchronizations and prevents the bucket from logically exceeding its maximum capacity.

Merge overlapping or adjacent intervals within a specified gap.

Args:
    spans: Iterable of (start, end) pairs representing intervals.
    gap: Maximum distance between adjacent intervals to consider merging (default 0).

Returns:
    List of merged (start, end) tuples sorted by start time.
Tokens refill at a fixed rate. Each request consumes one; if empty, requests are blocked. This enforces average rate limits while allowing temporary traffic bursts.
